about.description: Altai offers a stablecoin backed by real-world assets and Treasury securities, combining yield generation with price stability. It enables institutional-grade stable settlement with underlying RWA collateral.
about.registryInfo: Altai is a tokenization platform issuing tokenized real-world asset tokens backed by physical commodities and metals.

fees.revenueNotes: Altai earns primary-market spreads on tokenized metal issuances and ongoing storage/insurance fees on physical inventory held in custody.
